action.message: Always consult the canonical external source (design mocks for UI, source code for gap assessments, user-authored specs for authority) before generating any claim that could be derived from it — never substitute an internal approximation for a readable original.

When fixing a pattern instance or verifying a change, always enumerate all other consumers/pages/states that share the same pattern or component before declaring the fix complete — a fix scoped to the triggering instance is half a fix.

Avoid halting for sequential progress confirmation unless a genuine decision point requires user-held information; when halting, always include prior context, concrete options, and tradeoffs so the question is answerable in one reply.

Always identify the canonical remote source (the peer's ack, the user's spec, the running app) before treating any locally-produced artifact (a send log, a derived doc, a notification) as evidence of the remote state.

Always survey the full affected surface (all sibling pages, design mocks, existing patterns) before implementing any change — depth-first on the first item encountered consistently misses patterns and context that a breadth-first scan would have revealed.

When hitting any capability boundary that cannot be crossed autonomously, immediately package completed findings and the exact user-actionable command into a structured handoff rather than attempting workarounds or stalling.
